description: Review a selected property's source facts and missing evidence for one requested property-tax research service. Choose service_type from list_property_services. The result describes available research actions; it does not verify savings, quote a payable fee, charge, prepare a filing packet or submit a correction. Test checkout is a separate account workflow.

address.description: Explicitly selected property street address or parcel ID. A nonblank address takes precedence over parcel_id.

county_key.description: Exact registered county adapter key, such as hamilton; restricts source lookup to that county.

parcel_id.description: Explicitly selected county parcel ID / PIDN, used when address is absent or blank.

service_type.description: Explicit research service selected from list_property_services. Accepted aliases include demolished_outbuilding, square_footage_correction, mailing_address_change, commercial_reclassification and certified_tax_ledger. No service is assumed.

name: review_property_service
